title: The Genie One desktop app for macOS is in Beta
body: The Genie One desktop app is now in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). The native macOS app opens Genie One on your desktop instead of in a browser tab, so business users can chat with data in natural language, work with their threads and documents, and use Genie Agents without a browser. See [Use Genie One on desktop](/aws/en/genie-one/desktop).
